name: Tongues
overview: The New Testament presents tongues as a miraculous gift given by the Holy Spirit to early Christians, enabling them to speak in new or diverse languages as a sign of God's power and presence, as seen in Mark 16:17 and the Pentecost event in Acts 2:1. The apostle Paul describes tongues as one of many spiritual gifts distributed within the church, alongside prophecy, healing, and miracles (1 Corinthians 12:10, 12:28), emphasizing that not all believers receive this gift (1 Corinthians 12:30). Furthermore, Paul teaches that tongues, like other spiritual gifts, are temporary and will cease, highlighting the enduring supremacy of love (1 Corinthians 13:8).
